csv_project_name: Consultant for Transportation Element Comprehensive Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Conway, South Carolina ( City ) is requesting Statements of Qualifications (SOQs) from qualified consulting firms to prepare a Transportation Element as part of the City s Comprehensive Plan update process. The purpose of this Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is to identify and select a qualified consulting firm with demonstrated expertise in transportation planning, multimodal mobility planning, and comprehensive planning services for municipalities and regional agencies.
csv_disciplines_requested: Housing & Urban Development, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Transportation Planning, Urban Studies/Planning/Design
csv_comments: '- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 06/15/2026 02:00 PM EDT
title: Consultant for Transportation Element Comprehensive Plan
short_description: Consulting services for a municipal transportation element within a comprehensive plan update.
project_scope: Preparation of a Transportation Element for the City of Conway's Comprehensive Plan update, focused on transportation planning, multimodal mobility planning, and municipal/regional comprehensive planning. No specific structural works, spans, floor areas, or construction quantities are stated.
services: Consulting services for transportation planning, multimodal mobility planning, comprehensive planning, land use planning, and urban studies/planning/design; submission of statements of qualifications under an RFQ.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a pure transportation/comprehensive planning assignment, not structural or bridge design.
- Scope is urban planning and mobility strategy rather than engineering of buildings, bridges, roofs, or special structures.
- No technical structural component, no planning of load-bearing structures, and no construction-related design phases are indicated.
- The brief matches excluded categories such as pure urban/open space planning and planning/master planning.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The assignment is a planning/consulting service for a transportation element within a comprehensive plan, with no defined construction project or physical scope from which a realistic construction cost estimate could be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee or budget information is provided in the source. As this is an RFQ for planning services without stated contract value, no reliable fee estimate can be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified consulting firms with demonstrated expertise in transportation planning, multimodal mobility planning, and comprehensive planning services for municipalities and regional agencies.
contracting_authority: City of Conway, South Carolina; Contact: Damon Kempski; Phone: 843-248-1730; Fax: 843-248-1769; Email: procurement@conwaysc.gov; Website: https://www.conwaysc.gov/departments/procurement/index.php
notes: Although the target market is listed as Streets/Highways, the actual scope is strategic transportation planning for a comprehensive plan update, not bridge or structural engineering. Questions deadline: 06/15/2026 02:00 PM EDT. Solicitation documents available online.
